description.zh: 更新后的水印模板配置。JSON对象，更多信息请参见[水印模板配置详情](~~29253~~)。
description.en: The updated configuration of the watermark template. The value is a JSON object. For more information, see [Parameter details](~~29253~~).

description.zh: 更新后的模板名称。支持中英文、数字等，最大长度128字节。
description.en: The new name of the watermark template. The value can contain letters and digits and can be up to 128 bytes in size.

description.zh: 需要更新的水印模板ID，可以通过**MPS控制台**>**全局设置**>**水印模板**获取。
description.en: The ID of the watermark template that you want to update. To obtain the ID of the watermark template, you can log on to the **ApsaraVideo Media Processing (MPS) console** and choose **Global Settings** > **Watermark Templates** in the left-side navigation pane.

descriptions.zh:
- 本接口通过指定水印模板ID对水印模板的名称、配置等信息进行更新。
- 如果有状态为“已提交”的作业指定使用该水印模板，则相应的水印模板不能被更新。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~342832~~)。
descriptions.en:
*   You can call this operation to update the information about a watermark template based on the ID of the watermark template. For example, you can update the name and configurations of a watermark template.
*   A watermark template cannot be updated if it is being used by a job that has been submitted.

### QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 100 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you will experience service interruptions. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation. For more information, see [QPS limit](~~342832~~).
